features.name: make-the-h1-contain-only-text
features.title: Make the h1 contain only text
features.description:
---
name: hero-h1-text-only
capabilities:
  - templates-i18n
---

## Why

The HeroSection in `apps/site` currently wraps a `<span class="text-fg-muted">` prefix inside the `<h1>`, paired with a separate `headlineMuted` i18n key. The desired hero is a single plain-text headline; the muted prefix and its translations should be removed.

> Note: `apps/site/` is a marketing mirror, not a template. Only files under `apps/site/` are in scope for this change — do **not** modify `packages/templates/starter/`.

## Acceptance

- `apps/site/src/components/landing/HeroSection.astro` renders only `{t('landing.hero.headlineTail')}` as the single child of the `<h1>` (no nested span, no muted prefix)
- `apps/site/src/i18n/en.json` no longer contains a `landing.hero.headlineMuted` key
- `apps/site/src/i18n/es.json` no longer contains a `landing.hero.headlineMuted` key
- `pnpm typecheck` is green
- `pnpm build --filter @astro-ignite/site` is green

features.name: add-e2e-testing-to-all-templates-and-app
features.title: Add e2e testing to all templates and apps
features.description:
## Problem

Templates (`packages/templates/starter`, `packages/templates/docs`) and apps (`apps/site`, `apps/docs`, `apps/playground`) currently have no e2e test coverage. `pnpm scaffold:test` validates that the CLI can scaffold + build + pass Lighthouse, but there are no behavior tests for actual user flows (navigation, locale switching, theme toggle, contact form, search, etc.).

## Proposal

Add an e2e test suite (Playwright recommended) that runs against:

**Templates** (run against `pnpm dev` of the template directly):
- [ ] `packages/templates/starter/`
- [ ] `packages/templates/docs/`

**Apps**:
- [ ] `apps/site/`
- [ ] `apps/docs/`
- [ ] `apps/playground/` (smoke only — it's CI-regenerated)

## Coverage per target

At minimum each target should verify:
- [ ] Homepage renders without console errors
- [ ] Internal navigation works (header links, footer links)
- [ ] Locale switcher swaps routes correctly (if i18n configured)
- [ ] Theme toggle cycles light/dark/system and persists
- [ ] 404 page renders
- [ ] Per-template specifics:
  - starter: contact form submission (mocked email), blog index → post navigation
  - docs: sidebar nav, search (if present), MDX page renders
